action_instruction: Checking product price formatting in search results
intent: whether every monetary price shown in the product result cards is formatted as US dollars with two decimal places

action_params.condition: Every product price on this page is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00.
action_params.query: whether every monetary price shown in the product result cards is formatted as US dollars with two decimal places

action_instruction: Checking cart and order summary amount formatting
intent: whether every dollar amount in cart or order summary regions of the page is formatted as US dollars with two decimal places

action_params.condition: Every amount in a cart or order summary on this page is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00; shipping may say Free.
action_params.query: whether every dollar amount in cart or order summary regions of the page is formatted as US dollars with two decimal places

assertion_tree.description: Every product price, and every amount in a cart or order summary, is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00; shipping may say Free. If nothing on this page falls under this rule, it holds.

sub_results.description: Every product price on this page is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00.
Every amount in a cart or order summary on this page is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00; shipping may say Free.

assertion_tree.verification: Product prices and amounts in any cart or order summary on the current page.
